body:
## Summary

Fix four direct regressions from the merge sequence in #791:

- Keep one six-attempt UNKNOWN poll after #787/#753 duplicated it (twelve waits before the fix).
- Accept hosted reconciliation success only for the PR or merge SHA; an unrelated or unidentified run cannot skip the local reconciler.
- Reconcile the inventory baseline introduced by #783 with the GitHub-label connector landed in #723.
- Use the canonical tracked cleanup package in the new hosted-lookup test so it works in fresh clones.

Closes #791. The unrelated idle-control parallel failure is filed as [#793](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/issues/793) and held; this PR contains its intake/evidence only.

## Prior-Art & Ground Truth

- [x] Reviewed all five listed PRs plus preceding #761/#783 against `a2312944..337813e0`; checked current open PRs for overlap.
- [x] Direct-source recon and independent read-only review across cleanup, state/labels, express, reconciliation, vendor, HQ, and governance.
- [x] Witnessed the hosted identity, six-poll, inventory, and fresh-clone import failures before repairs.

## Proof of Done

- [x] `bash test/gh436-merge-cleanup.sh` — 180 tests passed.
- [x] Hosted-lookup suite — 6 tests passed; bounded-poll focused tests — 6 passed.
- [x] Inventory positive/negative controls passed; frozen-twin guard — 38 pass, 0 fail.
- [x] Full macOS pre-push gate — **419/419 passed** at `14640c75`, no bypass (1,262 seconds).
- [x] Six targeted documentation checks and release-ledger consistency check passed.

[Review and receipts](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/blob/fix/gh791-merge-regressions/TESTS-RESULTS/2026-09-24%2BGH-791/REVIEW.md) include committed provenance. The baseline full run was intentionally terminated after known failures and is not claimed as a completed gate.

## Governance & PDDA

- [x] #791 reopened; capture/status and roadmap updated.
- [x] #793 parked for separate work; no unrelated runtime changes.
- [x] No routine generated views committed. Code/test/baseline changes are narrowly scoped; most added lines are retained test output.

No live merge, teardown, or issue-label projection was performed for verification.

The follow-up commit updates documentation/receipts only; runtime and test sources are identical to the full-gated revision. This is local verification, not release-promotion evidence.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Merge completion now requires a successful hosted run tied to the pull request or merge commit; unrelated or unidentified runs can’t falsely confirm success.
  * Unidentified active runs may continue to delay merging while the system waits for a matching result.
  * Mergeability checks now occur after hold-label and pull-request state checks, avoiding unnecessary polling.

* **Documentation**
  * Added records of the merge workflow updates, verification results, and a separate idle-control investigation.
